title: ID0405567-DC/Si-D/NO-[bucVuF] Charger sending OCPP preparing
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Stuck in Preparing
Root cause:
Bus driver is not connecting plug correctly and doesn't establish SLAC communication as such when they leave the bus in B1/B2 it will stay in preparing until they plug out
Solution:
Inform the bus drivers and replug
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: ID0405567-DC/Si-D/NO-[bucVuF] Charger sending OCPP preparing CRM:00315002345
additional_info.body:
Just for documentation:
Stuck in Preparing
I checked all the sessions you provided (except Heliox chargers) and the main root cause on why it’s getting “stuck” is because the customer is plugging in the EV, it fails to start the session properly, and as they leave the truck there unattended, it keeps sending the Preparing status until they plug out, if you check when the PilotState goes from B2->A, B1->A, E->A you will see that the Status will be Available and not preparing anymore.
The secondary root causes are:
From the SECC side we get that the EV is closing the TCP connection during Parameter Discovery
Working case
Non-working
As you can see, the EV didn’t send the PilotState C and as such we didn’t start the session.
When customer plugs in, it doesn’t plug in properly and fails to establish the SLAC communication (CP and PP), we see the A->B2 but it doesn’t go to the next phase with the following error:
As you can see it didn’t even share the EVCCID.
This one we could get the MAC but not the CCID
Regarding this SLAC communication there shouldn’t be any problem from the charger, I will bring the topic regarding the failing during Parameter Discovery for further investigation.
